headline: Context-aware filtering and transcript-specific k-mers target mapping ambiguity in isoform quantification
label: Transcript Quantification Ambiguity Reduction
summary: New preprints refine isoform quantification by modeling long-read MAPQ and isolating transcript-specific regions, alongside long-read preprocessing and annotation tools.
synthesis: The dominant thread is reducing mapping ambiguity in transcript-level quantification. CALMeR conditions long-read MAPQ filtering on transcript context using zero-one inflated beta regression, improving spike-in transcript recovery relative to fixed thresholds. A minimal-sharing k-mer strategy isolates transcript-specific regions to reduce ambiguity in short-read isoform quantification. Adjacent items address upstream or downstream steps rather than quantification itself: DirectClean preprocesses ONT direct-cDNA reads and rescues recoverable ones, SQANTI-evidence annotates unannotated genomes from long-read data, and LRP2 adds mass-spec evidence to isoform analysis. Edi-Set-Flow, Ribotools, tModBase v2.0, TISCA2/IncepTIS and a mitochondrial RNA intermediate tool cover narrower questions in editing, translation, tRNA modification and RNA processing.
